notes: Desktop unit (94.2 x 94.2 x 22.3mm), no rack ears — rackUnits omitted. Physical port layout and labels (POWER, ETHERNET, HDMI OUT, HDMI IN, AUDIO OUT, AUDIO IN, USB FLASH DRIVE/USB Modem) confirmed via the official Magewell Ultra Stream user manual diagram (magewell.com/files/documents/User_Manual/ultra_stream_family_user_manual_app_v1.4.34_en.pdf, page 6). HDMI grade set to hdmi-1.4 per manufacturer spec sheet stating 'HDMI Input and loop-through interfaces: HDMI 1.4a, DVI-D' (max signal support up to 4096x2160 60fps 4:2:0 exceeds strict 1.4a bandwidth on paper, but the device explicitly states its HDMI interface generation is 1.4a — likely using chroma subsampling/compression tricks or the spec sheet is imprecise; taking the manufacturer's stated interface version at face value). USB port type/version (2.0 Type-A) confirmed via B&H Photo listing and multiple retailer sources, not explicit in the manufacturer PDF's prose but shown in the manual's port diagram as a standard USB-A shape. Power input is DC 5V/2A external barrel-style adapter (accessory list includes 'AC adapter'); mapped to dc-barrel as the closest connector type in the allowed list. A sister product, Ultra Stream SDI, has identical chassis/ports except HDMI IN/OUT are replaced with SDI IN/OUT (BNC) — not included here since this record is for the HDMI variant only.

ports.name: HDMI IN
ports.note: HDMI 1.4a/DVI-D; supports up to 4096x2160 60fps (4:2:0) or 30fps (4:4:4/4:2:2); 8-channel embedded audio

ports.name: HDMI OUT
ports.note: Loop-through of HDMI IN signal, same HDMI 1.4a/DVI-D spec

ports.name: AUDIO OUT
ports.note: 3.5mm analog headphone output, extracts audio from HDMI signal for monitoring

ports.name: USB (Flash Drive / USB Modem)
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type-A; for USB flash drive recording or 3G/4G USB modem (modem not included)

ports.name: POWER
ports.note: DC 5V/2A via included AC adapter; max consumption ~9.6W
